summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime to execute a bundled obfuscated payload
details: pob-test-typescript-package-in-monorepo@4.2.17 declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime binary from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip into a temp directory, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary to 0755, then execFileSyncs it to run a locally shipped 727KB file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a Bun-compiled CJS bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) using heavy string-array/index obfuscation (shuffled numeric+string array, a `WV8StW` array-rotator function, hex-named identifiers such as `_0x488df8`/`_0x52943e`). The package's declared source is a trivial two-line `Hello ${name}!` export; the advertised functionality does not require an alternate language runtime or a large opaque bundle. Fetching a non-Node runtime at preinstall solely to execute an obfuscated payload bypasses Node-focused install-time scanners and gives arbitrary code execution on the installer's host during `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
